tx: It takes roughly around 145-150 summer pies to get the legs from 80 Agility. In the process, the player will most probably gain 81 Agility. At 80 Agility, it is usually 1 bite per lap. However with extreme luck, and gaining a failure rate of just 6.9% or lower, a player can still gain the legs with only 80 Agility.

tx:
An effective way to boost is using the untradeable Stamina potions made with 77 Herblore, each dose provides a temporary 6 level boost. A cheaper alternative way to boost is using Summer pies, at one bite per lap, it will take between 130 and 170 pies to get 250 perfect laps if starting the course at level 85 Agility. Additionally, toadflax incense sticks provide up to a 50% chance to avoid failing an agility obstacle. These perfect laps do not need to be done consecutively. It's advised to get level 86 because this makes it so only one bite is needed per 2-3 laps, depending on how fast the player is. It is also advised to use a god banner or an abyssal lurker scroll.
Before reaching the required laps to obtain the top if you speak to Gunnjorn and select "Can I talk about rewards", he will reply with "There's no reward for you just yet. Your lap count is only (Amount). It's 250 successful laps or no reward."
When 250 laps have been completed without falling, the following message appears in the chatbox: "You've completed 250 perfect laps! Speak to Gunnjorn to collect your reward." 
The fastest possible time that a full lap can be completed in is 35.4 seconds (59 game ticks). Thus, obtaining the top takes a minimum of 2.5 hours (2:27:30), which may be halved by using 10 Agile outfit enhancers.
